comment: The four mode parameters have no widgets on the panel and live only on the right-click menu. The four quantising algorithms differ in what they round: Index down, up and round work on the note's position in the twelve-note table, so they can pick a note that is further away in pitch than another; Nearest compares actual pitches (TrackerQuant.cpp:7-45). Where two or more of the twelve notes are tuned to the same pitch, which the manual describes as merging notes, the table becomes a scale and this quantises to it.
